Thanks — good start. I want to formalize a short req governance rubric we can use immediately for the QBR. Proposed gating criteria (binary pass/fail per req):

1) Customer impact: does lack of hire pose a >30% SL risk or block a committed deliverable?
2) Revenue velocity: will this hire materially (>=5% forecast delta) change revenue next two quarters?
3) Security/Compliance/regulatory dependency: required to remediate a live finding or support a contract clause.
4) Time-to-value / backlog criticality: will the role remove an unaddressed operational bottleneck within 60 days?

My recommendation: Approve only roles that pass at least two of the above OR are backfills for roles already tied to SLA/production support. That yields 4 approved reqs today (both SREs, Inference infra, and a critical infra engineer flagged in tab C). Defer/deprioritize the rest until we have a finance checkpoint in the QBR.

I attached a short governance playbook with examples and a proposed approval matrix. If leadership agrees, we should publish the rubric to hiring managers and have them reclassify pending reqs by EOD 9/1.

-Markus
